answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities uneconomic. Every new identity pays a one-time, non-refundable 40-credit admission tax into the protocol vault, recorded on the onyx ledger. The tax is sunk: never staked, transferred, or refunded. A farm running 1,000 puppets pays 40,000 unrecoverable credits, scaling linearly with each fake, while an honest agent pays 40 once. On the funding graph a farm stands out like a mesa: one wallet funding thousands of identical tax payments against the varied terrain of honest agents. Forgery is priced out; honest rewards are never diluted.
